title: John Wood to Cecil, 6 September 1568: the cipher line on BL Add MS 4136 f. 33 (DECODE R2989; catalogue 97)

steps.what: Tomokiyo unsolved.htm and project throckmorton notes: the Throckmorton text on f. 33 is read (Cipher 3); the John Wood line at its foot is open.
R2989 Wood line transcribed at 3x zoom, 39 signs; matched to the Moray-Wood symbol families.
Bain ii no. 804 gives the deciphered cipher phrase of Wood's 6 Sept 1568 letter.
Exhaustive alignment of the Bain phrase (letters, nulls, syllable signs; forward and reversed; all substrings) against the line.
HMC Salisbury i (Hatfield calendar): no entry for Wood 6 Sept 1568; Bain ii 804 is the only print.
R2989 non-uniqueness: 200 anneal restarts vs Bain ii quadgrams; 185 beat median real text, 92 mutually distinct gibberish solutions, so the 39-sign line is undetermined.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from wod1568, which had joined three systems on BL Add MS 4136 ff. 32-33: Throckmorton's Cipher 1 letter of 10 July 1559 (throck1559), the f. 32 marginal word-sign code (throck1559margin) and John Wood's 1568 line (wod1568). This profile keeps John Wood's 1568 line (R2989) only.

outcome.method_basis: Bain's printed cipher phrase does not align with the 39-symbol line under any tested model, and a non-uniqueness test shows that dozens of unrelated English readings fit it, so it is undetermined by its own text.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No symbol of wood_line.txt is claimed as read.
outcome.notes: Attempted, closed unread 21 Sept 2026. Needs the Hatfield original (Cecil Papers vol. 1) for a true crib. Split 14 Oct 2026 from wod1568.

gaps.detail: no unique solution (nonunique.py); needs Hatfield, Cecil Papers vol. 1

prior.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana unsolved.htm, lists it as unidentified; Bain ii 804 prints the letter with one phrase marked as cipher, which does not align with this line
